entry_conditions: The policy can enter from the closed start or from an intermediate side-pull state when causal observations provide the two most recent world-frame states: TCP pose, red pose, drawer_position in metres, drawer_velocity, qpos/qvel, and finger opening. Supported starts include drawer_position near 0 with the red block at about z=0.063 m and the TCP above or approaching, and supported mid-skill starts include the overlap after the drawer is already open if the gripper has released.
exit_conditions: Prefer exit after drawer_position is strictly greater than 0.26 m and normally near the 0.30 m open stop, drawer_velocity is near zero, the fingers are open, and the TCP has retreated upward/away from the pulled red block rather than continuing to apply side-pull force. The model also learns the 240-330 transition, so it may be continued after first threshold crossing until the release and retreat are visible in the causal state.
overlap_role: In the shared 240-330 phase, this policy treats drawer progress as already achieved and learns the transition from progress-controlled pulling to open-finger retreat toward the successor top-grasp setup. The overlap is not a separate scripted controller; it is included in the same learned action diffusion distribution.
successor_readiness: A successor should receive a stable open drawer state: drawer_position above 0.26 m, close to 0.30 m, small drawer_velocity, red block still reachable outside the drawer, fingers open, and TCP no longer clamped in the side-pull contact pose. These cues are all available causally from the state fields in world units.
failure_signatures: Observed warning signs include drawer_position failing to increase during the closed-finger pull, drawer_position decreasing or oscillating, drawer_velocity inconsistent with the intended pull, fingers opening before drawer_position exceeds 0.26 m, or the red block/TCP separating laterally far outside the demonstrated side-grasp relation. These are inferred monitoring cues, not hard rejection thresholds proven to recover the task.
continuation_guidance: Continue this policy while drawer_position is below the 0.26 m open threshold or while the gripper has not yet completed the demonstrated release/retreat after opening. If invoked after the drawer is already open, the observation-conditioned phase features allow the model to skip active pulling and produce the transition motions learned in the overlap. Transfer once the successor can top-grasp without inheriting active side-pull contact.
limitations: The handoff description relies on observed state support and the trained diffusion prior; it is not a contact oracle. The implementation does not include IK, FK-based TCP velocity constraints, image perception, or guaranteed recovery from a lost or slipped grasp. The learned lateral-effect prior only encourages demonstrated red-block y/z stability and cannot prove physical containment or force closure.
